fusions.name: Cold-Shod Blow
fusions.desc: A blow with the staff's shod end that deals 30 damage ignoring resistances and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Spell-Breaking Sweep
fusions.desc: You sweep the cold grey length of the staff through a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 5 damage with a 25% chance to leave each enemy [Muddled] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Unbending
fusions.desc: You set the staff and stand behind it: for 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Grey Turns Spells
fusions.desc: The cold iron worked into the staff turns magic: 15% of the elemental damage you take is returned to whoever dealt it.
